title: Flametal shield

infobox.Crafting Materials: Ashwood x20, Flametal x8, Asksvin hide x4

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Flametal shield is the sixth round shield, craftable from Ashlands materials.
It has less block power compared to the Flametal tower shield but can be used to parry enemy attacks.
